# spaceman mfa

Your second factor: TOTP enrollment and recovery codes.

| Subcommand | Description |
|---|---|
| [`spaceman mfa confirm`](#spaceman-mfa-confirm) | Confirm TOTP enrollment with a code; the recovery codes are shown once |
| [`spaceman mfa enroll`](#spaceman-mfa-enroll) | Start TOTP enrollment; the otpauth URI (the TOTP secret) is shown once |
| [`spaceman mfa recovery-codes`](#spaceman-mfa-recovery-codes) | Replace your recovery codes (the old ones stop working) |

## spaceman mfa confirm

Confirm TOTP enrollment with a code; the recovery codes are shown once.

```sh
spaceman mfa confirm [flags]
```

API: `confirm-enroll` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--code-file` | string |  | current TOTP code from the authenticator app (read from this file; never pass secrets as flag values) |
| `--code-stdin` | bool |  | read --code-file's value from standard input instead |
| `-f`, `--file` | string |  | request body as a JSON or YAML file (- reads standard input); flags override its fields |
| `--secret-file` | string |  | write the one-time secret to this new file (mode 0600) instead of printing it |
| `--show-secret` | bool |  | print the one-time secret (shown once; without this or --secret-file the command refuses to run) |

## spaceman mfa enroll

Start TOTP enrollment; the otpauth URI (the TOTP secret) is shown once.

Import the otpauth URI into an authenticator app (most read it from a file or a QR code made from it), then finish with `spaceman mfa confirm` and a code from the app.

```sh
spaceman mfa enroll [flags]
```

API: `start-enroll` ([HTTP API](../api)).

Example:

```sh
spaceman mfa enroll --secret-file ./totp.uri
spaceman mfa confirm --code-stdin --secret-file ./recovery-codes
```

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--secret-file` | string |  | write the one-time secret to this new file (mode 0600) instead of printing it |
| `--show-secret` | bool |  | print the one-time secret (shown once; without this or --secret-file the command refuses to run) |

## spaceman mfa recovery-codes

Replace your recovery codes (the old ones stop working).

```sh
spaceman mfa recovery-codes [flags]
```

API: `regenerate-recovery-codes` ([HTTP API](../api)).

| Flag | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `--secret-file` | string |  | write the one-time secret to this new file (mode 0600) instead of printing it |
| `--show-secret` | bool |  | print the one-time secret (shown once; without this or --secret-file the command refuses to run) |
| `--yes` | bool |  | confirm: replace your recovery codes |
